plain: One who firmly states or defends a claim or right.

webster.text: One who affirms positively; one who maintains or vindicates a claim; an affirmer, supporter, or vindicator.

example.quote: The East India company, who till that time had never sent a pound of tea to America on their own account, step forth on that occasion the assertors of parliamentary right, and send hither many ship loads of that obnoxious commodity.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, A Summary View of the Rights of British America, 1774
